Monthly Quest Points Keep Going Up. Two months ago my quest points to get the monthly badge went up to 55 points. Now it's gone up to 65 points. It's demotivating to be pushed to do more and I end up doing easy lessons that don't actually help me learn the language. I'd rather be given the option each month to choose a monthly goal with a minimum of 45 points and CHOOSE if I'd want to push for more. Right now, I push to make sure I get it and then it keeps going up!

5-10 years ago, I liked this app. it has become so gamified, so saturated with gimmicks and ads, that it is borderline unusable. Additionally, the lack of a true guided curriculum has become clearer and clearer with time. The exercises have no real progression and the lack of any explanatory material before introducing new words, patterns, or grammar is not conducive to language learning. It is unusable in its current state and there are now so many other free alternatives, why bother?
